writeup: TIC 152160223 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 3.3332 days, detected through automated analysis of TESS photometry. The primary eclipse produces a 4.81% dimming signal with a detection significance of 73.6 in the periodogram search, while no secondary eclipse was detected. Pixel-level image analysis confirms the signal originates near the target location, with a centroid offset of 2.0 arcsec and a peak signal-to-noise ratio of 16.5 in difference imaging. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a previously unlisted object. The machine-learning classifier assigns it a moderate score of 0.39, and the data passed all quality checks without flags.
